DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。転入の記入でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble filling in your move-in registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄と同じ建物に住むのですが、同居の欄をどう書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄と同じ建物へ転入する際の同居欄の書き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will live in the same building as my older brother. How should I fill in the field about living together?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to fill in the cohabitation field when moving into the same building as your older brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ部屋で生活するのですか。それとも部屋が分かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you live in the same apartment, or will you have separate apartments?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄は二〇一、私は二〇二です。食事も支払いも別にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄と別部屋で食事と支払いも別と生活実態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My brother is in 201, and I will be in 202. We will have separate meals and pay our expenses separately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your actual living arrangements: separate apartments, meals, and payments from your brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ建物というだけで同じ世帯とは決められません。実際の生活状況を担当へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Living in the same building alone does not determine whether you are one household. Let us explain the actual living arrangements to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同居と書きかけたので、まだ提出せずに担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同居と書きかけたため提出前に担当へ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I started writing that we live together, so I would like to check with the person in charge before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you started entering that you live together and want to check with the person in charge before submitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所の部屋番号が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a document showing the apartment number in your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の契約書があります。建物名は兄と同じですが、部屋は二〇二です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の契約書を示し兄と同じ建物だが二〇二号室と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my rental agreement. The building name is the same as my brother's, but my apartment is 202.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your own rental agreement and explain in Japanese that you will be in apartment 202 in the same building as your brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その資料と暮らし方を担当へ示してください。担当の案内で欄を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show that document and explain how you will live to the person in charge. You will select the field according to their instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別の部屋で別に生活すると説明します。同居欄は案内を聞いてから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別室で別生活だと説明し担当案内後に同居欄を記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that we live separately in different apartments. I will fill in the cohabitation field after hearing the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you live separately in different apartments and will fill in the cohabitation field after the person in charge's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。契約書をお持ちになって担当へどうぞ。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your agreement to the person in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。予約についてお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十時の予約ですが、仕事が長引いて九時五十分に着きます。間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十時診察に対し九時五十分到着で間に合うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My appointment is at ten, but work has run late and I will arrive at nine fifty. Will I be in time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether arriving at nine fifty will be in time for a ten o'clock consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約票には九時半の受付案内もあります。そちらは見ていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The appointment slip also says to check in at nine thirty. Had you seen that?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察の十時だけ見ていました。受付時刻とは違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察時刻だけ見て別の受付時刻を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the ten o'clock consultation time. So that is different from the check-in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you only looked at the consultation time and missed the separate check-in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。到着が受付案内より遅れる点を担当へ伝えます。もう移動中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. I will tell the person in charge that you will arrive later than the stated check-in time. Are you already on your way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ職場です。今出れば九時五十分です。受けられないなら予定を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在職場で到着見込みを示し受診できない場合は予定を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am still at work. If I leave now, I will arrive at nine fifty. If I cannot be seen, I would like to discuss rescheduling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are currently at work, give your expected arrival time, and say you want to discuss plans if you cannot be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受診の扱いは担当が確認します。お名前と予約票の番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check whether you can be seen. Please give me your name and the number on your appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号はこちらです。確認が出る前に予約を取り消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約番号を提示し照会前に予約を取消さないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the number. Please do not cancel the appointment before we have the result of the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your appointment number and ask in Japanese that the appointment not be canceled before the inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の予約はそのまま担当へ照会します。連絡を受けられる番号は登録どおりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will keep the original appointment while checking with the person in charge. Is your contact number still the one registered?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号は変わっていません。到着見込みを伝えて、担当の回答で今日行くか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録番号で連絡を受け担当回答に基づき来院を判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My number has not changed. I will give my expected arrival time and decide whether to come today based on the person in charge's answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you can be reached at the registered number and will decide whether to visit based on the person in charge's answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡先を確認しました。担当からの案内をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed your contact details. Please wait for instructions from the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どうされましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自転車が駐輪場にありません。盗まれたと思うので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐輪場から自転車がなくなり盗難と思って相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bicycle is missing from the bicycle parking area. I think it was stolen, so I would like to ask for help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your bicycle is missing from the parking area and you think it has been stolen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所と時刻を教えてください。ほかに使える方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where and when you last saw it. Is there anyone else who can use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝に駅前へ置きました。友人が予備の鍵を持っていますが、今日は使わないはずです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝の駐輪場所と予備鍵を持つ友人の存在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I parked it in front of the station this morning. A friend has a spare key, but I do not think they are using it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese where you parked this morning and that a friend has a spare key.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人の方へ確認できますか。管理者による移動もまだ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check with your friend? We also still need to check whether the management moved it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今、友人から連絡が来ました。通路に出ていたので奥へ移したそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人から奥へ移動したという連絡が来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend has just contacted me. They say it was sticking out into the path, so they moved it farther inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your friend has contacted you to say they moved the bicycle farther inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、まずその場所の自転車がお客様のものか確認してください。ここでは発見したとはまだ記録しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please first check whether the bicycle in that place is yours. We will not record it as found here yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に写真を送ってもらいます。赤いサドルカバーで自分の物か見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の写真で赤いサドルカバーを照合したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask my friend to send a photo. I will look at the red saddle cover to see whether it is mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to compare the red saddle cover in a photo from your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真で似ていても、現物や登録情報で確認する必要があります。確認結果を知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if it looks similar in the photo, you need to check the actual bicycle or registration information. Please tell us the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真は私の自転車に見えます。奥の区画で現物を確認し、結果をこちらへ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真だけで発見と断定せず現物を確認して結果を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The photo looks like my bicycle. I will check the actual bicycle in the section farther inside and contact you with the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not decide it is found based only on the photo, but will check the actual bicycle and report the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在は確認中として伺います。足元に気を付けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will treat it as still being checked for now. Please watch your step when checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。発送前の確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you checking something before sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請書と返信用封筒を送ります。二つの封筒に同じ宛先を書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外封筒と返信用封筒の宛先を同じにするのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending an application form and a return envelope. Should I put the same destination address on both envelopes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the outer envelope and the return envelope should have the same destination address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外は提出先ですが、返信用は誰に返してもらうためのものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The outside is addressed to where you are submitting it, but who is the return envelope supposed to go back to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 結果を私へ送ってもらうものです。中の封筒も役所宛てに書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返信用は本人への結果返送用だが提出先を誤記したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is for sending the result back to me. I wrote the government office's address on the inner envelope too by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the return envelope is for sending the result to you, but you mistakenly wrote the submission destination on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返信用には返送先の住所を記入してください。外側の宛先と分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write the return delivery address on the return envelope. Keep that separate from the destination on the outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい内封筒に自分の住所を書きます。切手は今送る封筒と同じ金額ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人住所に書き直し返信用切手額が往信と同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write my own address on a new inner envelope. Should its stamp value be the same as for the envelope I am sending now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will rewrite the address as your own, and ask whether the return stamp amount is the same as for the outgoing envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返送物の重さや指定方法で変わります。提出先の案内には何とありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That depends on the weight of what is sent back and the required method. What do the instructions from the submission destination say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信用の切手額が載っていません。返ってくる書類の枚数も分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内に切手額がなく返送書類の枚数も不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: They do not list the return stamp amount. I do not know how many sheets will be sent back either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the instructions do not state the stamp amount and you do not know the number of documents to be returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先に提出先へ確認してください。こちらで中身の重さを推測して切手額は決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with the submission destination first. We cannot determine the stamp amount by guessing the contents' weight here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 返信先を自分に直し、切手条件を提出先へ聞いてから中へ入れます。今日はまだ封をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返送先を本人に訂正し提出先への切手条件確認まで封を閉じないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will correct the return address to my own, ask the submission destination about the stamp requirements, and then enclose it. I will not seal it today yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will correct the return address to your own and not seal the envelope until checking the stamp requirements with the submission destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。確認後にお持ちください。封筒をお返しします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please bring it after checking. Here are your envelopes back. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。口座のお申込みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you applying for an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この本人確認の資料で申し込めますか。更新したので新しい方があるはずです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 更新前と思われる本人確認資料で口座申込みができるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Can I apply using this identification document? I renewed it, so I should have a newer one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can apply for an account with identification that appears to be from before renewal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いまお持ちの資料は更新前ですか。記載された期限を一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the document you have now the one from before renewal? Please check the expiry date on it with me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 期限は先月です。古い方を財布に残して、新しい方は家に置いたと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 期限が先月で新しい資料は自宅に置いたと思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It expired last month. I think I left the old one in my wallet and the new one at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the expiry date was last month and you think the new document is at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い資料を最新として受付は進められません。必要な資料を担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot proceed by treating the old document as current. The person in charge will explain what documents are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい資料の写真だけなら携帯にあります。それで今日済ませられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新資料の写真だけで当日手続きできるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only have a photo of the new document on my phone. Can I complete the procedure today with that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the procedure can be completed that day using only a photo of the new document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真だけで受付できるかは担当の確認が必要です。完了をお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge needs to check whether a photo alone can be accepted. We cannot promise completion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 無理に進めず、持参が必要なものを一覧で教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付を急がず次回必要な持参物を一覧で知りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want to force the process ahead. I would like a list of what I need to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a list of the things to bring next time, without rushing the processing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の案内をメモできます。更新後の資料は家で現物を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can make a note of the person in charge's instructions. Please check the actual renewed document at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で新しい現物を探します。必要な持参物を聞き、今日完了したとは考えず準備し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 更新後の現物を探し必要資料を準備するため当日完了とはみなさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look for the new document itself at home. I will ask what I need to bring and prepare again, without assuming it was completed today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will look for the actual renewed document and prepare what is needed, so you will not consider it completed that day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当へご案内します。お持ちの資料はご自身で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take you to the person in charge. Please keep the documents you have with you in your own possession.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お買物でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物が重いので、このカートで家まで運んで戻してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い買物を店のカートで自宅へ運び返却できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shopping is heavy. May I use this cart to take it home and bring the cart back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can take heavy shopping home in the store's cart and then return it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では店の敷地内だけで利用するカートです。お帰りは徒歩ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, this cart may only be used within the store grounds. Will you be walking home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家は歩いて十分ほどです。返せば外へ持って行けると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 徒歩十分の自宅へ返却前提なら持出可能と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: My home is about a ten-minute walk away. I thought I could take it outside as long as I returned it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that home is ten minutes away on foot and you thought taking the cart out was allowed if you returned it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 敷地外へは出さず、別の持帰り方法を考えましょう。迎えに来られる方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us keep it within the grounds and think of another way to take your shopping home. Is there someone who can pick you up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夫に車で来てもらえます。待つ間、会計済みの荷物をカートに載せたままにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夫の車の迎えを頼み待つ間会計済荷物をカートに載せてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My husband can come by car. While I wait, can I leave the shopping I have already paid for in the cart?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will ask your husband for a pickup by car, and ask whether you can leave your paid shopping in the cart while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身のそばで管理し、通路を塞がない場所でお待ちください。未購入品とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep it by you and wait somewhere that does not block the path. Keep it separate from items you have not bought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートも手元にあります。入口から離れた待機場所で夫へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートを保持して入口から離れた場所で夫へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my receipt with me too. I will contact my husband from the waiting area away from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep the receipt and contact your husband from a place away from the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車は指定の乗降場所を使ってください。積み終えたカートは返却場所へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the designated pickup and drop-off area for the car. Once you have loaded it, return the cart to the return area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夫が来たら乗降場所で積み、カートを返します。家までカートを押す予定はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定乗降場所で積載後カートを返し自宅まで押す予定をやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: When my husband arrives, I will load the car in the pickup and drop-off area and return the cart. I will give up my plan to push the cart home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will return the cart after loading at the designated pickup and drop-off area and will abandon the plan to push it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。待機場所をお示しします。足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I will show you the waiting area. Please watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How may I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外で散歩中ですが、中止の放送がありました。どこで案内を聞けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩中の一時中止放送を受け案内を聞く場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am outside on a walk, and there was an announcement suspending activities. Where should I go to hear the instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to receive instructions after an announcement of a temporary suspension while you are walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では管理棟でご案内しています。同行者はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this situation, instructions are being given at the management building. Is anyone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が別の小道にいます。私だけ先に戻っていいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の小道にいる友人と離れており自分だけ戻るか迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is on another small path. I am unsure whether I should return by myself first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are separated from your friend on another path and are unsure whether to return alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人にも案内が届いているか連絡してください。集合場所は管理棟と伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please contact your friend to check whether they have also received the instructions. Tell them to meet at the management building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 管理棟で合流すると送ります。空が明るくなったらすぐ散歩を再開できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ管理棟集合を連絡し空の明るさだけで再開できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will send a message saying we should meet at the management building. If the sky brightens, can we resume our walk straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will tell your friend to meet at the management building, and ask whether the brightening sky alone means you can resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見た目だけでは再開の判断はできません。園の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot judge whether to resume just from appearances. Please wait for the park's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は帰る予定にして、友人にも散歩を終えると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 園の案内を待ち当日の散歩を終了すると友人へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will plan to go home today and tell my friend we are ending our walk too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wait for the park's instructions and tell your friend you are ending today's walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 友人が戻ったら、帰りに利用できる出口も係員へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When your friend returns, please also ask staff which exits you can use to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 管理棟で友人を待ちます。合流後に出口を確認して、一緒に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理棟で合流後に出口を確認して二人で帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for my friend at the management building. Once we meet, we will check the exit and go home together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the exit after meeting at the management building and the two of you will go home together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。こちらで案内をお待ちください。係員に引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please wait here for instructions. I will pass this on to a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。経路の案内が必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 向かいのホームへ行きたいのですが、いつもの連絡口が閉まっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雪で閉鎖された普段の連絡口から向かいホームへ移る方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to get to the platform opposite, but the connecting entrance I usually use is closed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to get to the opposite platform when the usual connecting entrance is closed due to snow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は雪のためその口を閉じています。館内の別の入口から回っていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That entrance is closed today because of snow. You will need to go around through another entrance inside the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は向かいで待っています。外を近道できると思いましたが、やめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 向かいで待つ友人がいるが外の近道は使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is waiting on the opposite side. I thought I could take a shortcut outside, but I will not do that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your friend is waiting opposite, but you will not take the shortcut outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 館内地図では、この通路から別の入口へつながります。友人にはどこで待つと伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The building map shows this passage leading to another entrance. Where will you tell your friend to wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 改札前まで戻ってもらいたいです。私が別入口へ回ることを連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に改札前へ戻ってもらい自分は別入口を回ると連絡する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like my friend to return to the front of the ticket gates. I will tell them I am going around to the other entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will ask your friend to return to the ticket gates and tell them you will go around through another entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札の内側か外側かも決めてください。友人の券の状態は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also decide whether you mean inside or outside the ticket gates. Do you know your friend's ticket status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人はまだ改札の外です。二人とも外側の案内板の前で会います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人は改札外なので外側の案内板前を集合地点に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend is still outside the ticket gates. We will both meet in front of the information sign on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the information sign outside as the meeting point in Japanese because your friend is outside the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら券を通さず合流できます。閉鎖した入口へ戻らないよう地図をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then you can meet without using your tickets to pass through. Please take the map so you do not return to the closed entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板前で合流してから一緒に入ります。雪のある近道ではなく館内通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 館内通路で合流してから二人で入場すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will meet in front of the information sign, then enter together. I will use the passage inside the building rather than the snowy shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will take the passage inside the building, meet, and then both enter together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。この地図をどうぞ。足元に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Here is the map. Please watch your step as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。証明書のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like to ask about a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月の証明書があります。住所は変わっていないので、就職先へこれを出していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所不変なら先月の証明書を就職先へ出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a certificate from last month. My address has not changed. Can I submit this to my new employer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can submit last month's certificate to your new employer if your address has not changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先が発行日について条件を示していますか。案内を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the submission destination specified any conditions about the issue date? Please show me the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今月発行のものとあります。住所だけ合えばいいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先は今月発行を指定しており住所だけを見ていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says it must be issued this month. I thought it was fine as long as the address matched.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the destination specifies issuance this month, but you were only checking the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その条件だと先月の物ではありません。必要な記載項目も同じ案内にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Under that condition, last month's certificate does not fit. Are the required entries listed in the same instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と住所です。前の証明書には家族の名前も載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 求められる氏名と住所に対し古い証明には家族名も載っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My name and address. My old certificate also lists my family members' names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the requested information is your name and address, while the old certificate also includes family members' names.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要項目を担当へ示し、新しい申請でどの範囲を載せるか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us show the required items to the person in charge and check what scope of information to include in a new application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の情報は求められていないので、本人分で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族情報は不要なので新しい本人分の申請を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family's information is not requested, so I would like to ask about a certificate for just myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that family information is unnecessary and you want to discuss a new application covering only yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内を添えて担当へお渡しください。発行後に日付と記載内容をご確認いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand the instructions to the person in charge along with your application. You will check the date and entries after it is issued.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今月の日付で本人の名前と住所が必要と伝えます。受取り時もその三点を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今月の発行日と本人氏名と住所の三点を申請と受取時に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say I need this month's issue date and my own name and address. I will check those three things when collecting it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the three items—the issue date this month, your own name, and your address—both when applying and collecting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当の番号をお取りください。古い証明書はお手元で保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please take a number for the person in charge. Keep the old certificate with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬の袋が二種類あります。最近変わったので、どちらも持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最近変わった薬の旧袋と新袋を両方持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two kinds of medication bags. My medication changed recently, so I brought both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you brought both the old and new medication bags because your medication changed recently.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在使っている方はどちらですか。処方日も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which one are you currently using? Do you know the prescription dates too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい白い袋が今の分で、古い緑の袋は使っていません。日付は袋にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在使用中の白い袋と未使用の旧緑袋を処方日と共に区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The new white bag is the current one, and I am not using the old green bag. The dates are on the bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the white bag currently in use from the old green bag not in use, along with the prescription dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つを分けて医療職へ見せましょう。今朝の薬について伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us separate the two and show them to a medical professional. Is there anything you want to say about this morning's medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝はまだ飲んでいません。ここで飲んでいいか、診察で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝は未服用で服用について医療職へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not taken it yet this morning. I would like to ask during the consultation whether I can take it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not taken this morning's medication and want to consult a medical professional about taking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飲む判断は医療職に確認します。受付では服用をご案内しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the decision about taking it with a medical professional. Reception will not give instructions to take medication.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では自己判断で飲まず、今朝は未服用と担当に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 服用を自己判断せず未服用の状態を担当へ引き継いでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not decide to take it myself. Please tell the person in charge I have not taken it this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the person in charge to be told you have not taken the medication, without deciding about taking it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を引き継ぎます。薬以外に持参した説明書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on. Have you brought any information sheets besides the medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい薬の説明書もあります。旧袋と分けて、新しい袋と一緒に診察で見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新薬の説明書を新袋とまとめ旧袋と分けて診察で見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the information sheet for the new medication too. I will keep it with the new bag, separately from the old bag, and show it during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will keep the new medication information sheet with the new bag, separate from the old one, and show it during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。変更と今朝の未服用を担当へ伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the person in charge about the change and that you have not taken the medication this morning. Please wait here.
